answer: To register, an agent stakes tokens and burns a small ember of reputation minted only through prior verified work. Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty derives from a per-epoch seed, then sign the result with a hardware-bound cipher key. Creating N sybils costs N stakes plus N burns, making mass reputation slot forgery economically irrational. The fable that cheap identities suffice collapses once attackers price the burn. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
